ItemID: NA; Title: Oscd Ad Adele 21; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I am more interested in gentle classical and crossover vocals right now.
ItemID: NA; Title: That's Christmas To Me; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: My Downton Abbey Christmas listening makes another Christmas vocal album appealing; I would try this.
ItemID: NA; Title: Ultimate Waylon Jennings; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Traditional country feels less suited to my current relaxed, melodic listening mood.
ItemID: NA; Title: Chronicle: 20 Greatest 1976; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I am not looking for a roots-rock collection this time.
ItemID: NA; Title: The Best of Bread; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: Gentle melodies and soft vocals sound like a good fit for a quiet evening; I would choose this.
ItemID: NA; Title: In The Lonely Hour; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Soulful contemporary pop is less appealing right now than the orchestral vocal music I have been enjoying.
ItemID: NA; Title: Every Great Motown Hit Remastered; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I am seeking a calmer listening session rather than a Motown hits collection.
ItemID: NA; Title: To All The Girls...; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The vocal-duet format interests me given my crossover listening, but I would preview it before choosing it.
ItemID: NA; Title: Chutes Too Narrow; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Indie rock does not closely match the classical and polished vocal albums I want now.
ItemID: NA; Title: Pet Shop Boys Discography: The Complete Singles Collection; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Electronic pop is not what I want for my current relaxed listening mood.
